value.rationale: A canonical social-network game with population imbalance has an exact, sharp finite quality-of-equilibrium law, transition at minority share one-third, and a full equilibrium welfare distribution, not just a worst-case asymptotic. The histogram quantifies how frequently each integration outcome is strategically stable, providing reproducible finite benchmarks for segregation and formation analyses. It is a motivated natural-class classification rather than an arbitrarily truncated census.
